title: Link your X account to XPS5
lead: This browser's x.com session goes to your PS5, so XPS5 opens signed in. No FTP, no files to copy.
step1: On the PS5, open XPS5, then Settings, X account, and press ✕. Or press Link from a PC where XPS5 says the session is missing.
step2: Make sure x.com is open in this browser with the account you want on the PS5.
step3: Scan the PS5's QR and press this extension's button on the page it opens, or type the address and the code the PS5 shows. Then press Link.
addressHint: As on the PS5's screen, for example 192.168.1.70
codeHint: Six digits, changed each time the screen opens
prefilled: The PS5's address and code are filled in. Check them and press Link.
noteSignOut: Do not sign out of X in this browser afterwards: X then ends the session on the PS5 as well. Closing the tab or the browser is fine.
notePrivacy: The extension reads only x.com's auth_token and ct0 cookies, sends them only to the address you type, over your home network, and keeps nothing but that address and the PS5's language.
badAddress: Type the address as the PS5 shows it: four numbers with dots, like 192.168.1.70.
notLocal: That is not an address of your home network. Type the one the PS5 shows.
noPermission: The browser needs your OK to talk to the PS5 at that address. Press Link again and allow it.
notFound: The PS5 did not answer at $1. Check that the linking screen is open in XPS5, that the PC and the PS5 are on the same network, and, if the browser asked about devices on your network, allow it.
signIn: This browser is not signed in to x.com. Sign in there, then come back and press Link.
checking: The PS5 is checking the session with X…
done: Done: @$1 is linked as account $2 on the PS5. You can close this tab.
wrongCode: Wrong code. Type the one on the PS5's screen ($1 tries left).
renewedCode: Too many wrong codes: the PS5 now shows a new one. Type that one.
xRefused: X did not accept this browser's session (HTTP $1). Reload x.com here, check you are signed in, and try again.
psOffline: The PS5 could not reach X to check the session. Check the PS5's internet connection.
psWrite: The PS5 could not save the session. Try again.
badCookies: This browser's x.com cookies do not look right. Sign out of x.com and sign in again, then press Link.
